description: This file is a shell script containing tests for the 'git' version control system, focusing on the usage of the 'previous branch' syntax '@{-n}'. It includes test cases for branch switching, merging, and reflog behavior related to '@{-n}'.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, runs a test script passed as an argument.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expected to fail, failing the test if it does not.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files for equality as part of test verification.
